For language capabilities, Bolaji has native proficiency in French and full professional proficiency in English. At Gozem, Bolaji was the first data hire in 2019. The initial team grew to 4, then expanded from 4 to 14+ professionals during the Head of Data period (October 2022 - March 2025). The organization supported five African operating markets (Togo, Benin, Cameroon, Congo, Gabon) and spanned eight analytics domains. Singapore was company headquarters only. He coordinated end-to-end onboarding for 12 hires from 50+ evaluated candidates with 30/60/90-day ramp milestones. The hiring rubrics, interview loops, and onboarding programs he designed are still in use across the function.

His management approach included:
- Recruiting and building distributed teams across multiple countries and cultures.
- Introducing effective processes, mentorship programs, and continuous learning initiatives.
- Leveraging LLM tools to boost team productivity and project delivery speed, including bringing Claude into leadership workflows and product engineering.
- Wearing multiple hats when needed: data architect, data engineer, analytics engineer, and data governance specialist.
- Pushing capability outward as much as upward: a self-service no-code exploration platform halved the routine query load on the central team by putting 12+ managers directly in the data.
